# 00000004562

**TR3-22 ◆** — source: 137_数论V_超越方法.md

**English.** Definition: The KZ periods conjecture asserts that period identities are generated by the basic relations. Conjecture: If a lowest-dimension counterexample exists, its dimension is at least three, and a three-dimensional counterexample must involve an explicit class of noncommutative motives. (lower dimension three of KZ counterexamples)

**中文。** 定义：KZ 周期猜想指周期等式由基本关系生成的猜想。猜想：最低维反例若存在则维数不低于三,且三维反例必须涉及非交换母题的显式类。（KZ 反例维数下界三）
